formulation.frozen_field: Hold center density at offset geometry; evaluate source scalar trace, HOS coefficients, body potential and body normal residual. No offset operator/factor/dense continuation maps.
formulation.derivative: A_current sigma_dot=(r_plus-r_minus)/(2h). Body phi_t equals frozen body-value derivative plus current density response minus actual centroid-chart convection.
formulation.coupling: Genuinely zero-world-linear/angular-acceleration poses own two frozen field actions and their centroid-chart derivative. A sigma_dot=b_known+W a; M a+C sigma_dot=f_known. Solve A+W M^-1 C without building six modal responses.
formulation.reference: Seven separate current solves form zero-acceleration known pressure and full6x6 modal fluid mass; no symmetrization. Prescribed oblique acceleration recombination must recover owned implicit derivative.

assessment: Frozen actions match full-context residuals below9e-16, potentials below1.7e-16 and surface pressure below1.1e-11Pa on both input boats.

Standalone speedup is NOT demonstrated. In first canonical screen two frozen actions cost0.930s versus0.839s for the matched full offset contexts. CPU scalar source trace accounts for0.849s of those actions. Box first screen actions0.453s versuscontexts0.525s. These are variable single-run component observations, not paired throughput measurements.

Canonical one-coupled-solve acceleration agrees with explicit7solve reference within6.6e-11, pressure1.3e-7Pa, prescribed-pressure reconstruction1.9e-9Pa. Box corresponding bounds6.3e-11,6.1e-8Pa,7.3e-9Pa.

Measured coupled solve0.298s canonical and0.102s box, each10GMRESiterations and no acceleration response basis or additional operator builds. These are current-state algebra costs, not full-RHS or trajectory timings.

Review correction: the first coupled audit subtracted W*a_prescribed from an accelerating centered residual, leaving O(h^2) geometry contamination in known_phi_t. Final implementation uses separately guarded zero-acceleration stencils. At common image0.45902726862203064 and expansion0.36733855903704704, h0.01->0.005s reduces reconstructed prescribed-pressure difference0.00014307->0.0000354585Pa (~4.03x). Coupled acceleration changes at most2.88e-6m/s2 and1.75e-6rad/s2 across this pair. This is local stencil evidence, not minute motion accuracy.

Final zero-acceleration canonical/box coupled solves retain modal agreement near1e-10 acceleration and1e-7Pa pressure. Single-solve times vary across screens; no seven-solve timing ratio or trajectory speedup claimed.
